opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000 to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the dairy and pig industries. In 2027 three dairy and three pig scholarships are planned.
opportunities.summary: A 30-day study programme for young people aged 18-24 to develop their understanding of the farming industry, staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars and building networks. Fully funded, including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference and Nuffield Farming Associate membership, plus a £1,000 incentive to cover replacement labour. Applications open in November 2026.
